caption: Day 3 of 30 family dinners toddlers actually eat 🤍 Cottage Cheese Protein Pizza 🍕 Ingredients: • 1 cup cottage cheese • 2 eggs • 60g flour • ½ tsp oregano • ½ tsp Italian seasoning • Tomato sauce • Shredded mozzarella cheese Directions: Blend the cottage cheese if desired → mix with eggs, flour, and seasonings → shape into individual pizzas or one large pizza → bake at 350°F (180°C) for 20 minutes → add tomato sauce and mozzarella → bake again until the cheese is melted ✨ Fluffy, cheesy, high in protein, and perfect for the whole family 🤍 If you want even more recipes like this, MunchMind has 200+ baby & toddler-approved recipes, plus weekly personalized meal plans already planned for you and grocery lists to make the whole week easier 🤍 Find it in my bio ✨ #familydinner #whatmytoddlereats #cottagecheese #toddlermeals #toddlerrecipes
